name: UFC | svc.populate_fight_card
description: Populates empty UFC Fight Cards using official UFC order and names, ESPN-verified rounds and verified athlete nicknames. Preserves existing cards and extracted picks.

parameters.jsCode: const items=$input.all();if(items.length!==1||!String(items[0].json.event_key||'').trim())throw new Error('Fight-card setup needs exactly one UFC event_key.');return items;

parameters.url: =https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/mma/ufc/scoreboard?dates={{ DateTime.fromISO($('Prepare UFC Card Request').first().json.event_datetime_local).minus({days:1}).toFormat('yyyyLLdd') }}-{{ DateTime.fromISO($('Prepare UFC Card Request').first().json.event_datetime_local).plus({days:1}).toFormat('yyyyLLdd') }}

parameters.jsCode:
const candidate=$('Build Verified UFC Card').first().json;
return candidate.card.flatMap(b=>['a','b'].map(side=>({json:{fighter_name:b['fighter_'+side],profile_url:b['fighter_'+side+'_url']}})));
